title: 第19章 白扶风第20章 一笔勾销
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 捧着馒头，沈修寒寻了个墙角靠坐下，小口小口啃着。
眼前微晃，一只小手抓着半块腌好的芥菜疙瘩递过来。
沈修寒愕然抬眼，发现旁边多了个十五六岁的少年。
他穿着满是补丁的旧袄，身形偏瘦，略显腼腆，一看便是外城人。
“师兄，就着咸菜吃吧，可香了…”
沈修寒微微一怔，倒也未推辞，伸手接过，顺势道：
“谢了，不过我今日方才入外院，按照规矩，理应唤你一声师兄才是。”
“我只比师兄早来两日，年纪小根骨也差，不敢不敢…”
少年连连摆手，挨着沈修寒身侧蹲下，语气羡艳道：
“晨练时，我瞧见沈师兄仅一上午练会了好几个桩架，武道达者为先，自该是我唤师兄。”
沈修寒吃人嘴软，索性借梅霜风的话宽慰道：
“师父说武道一途，最忌心浮气躁，桩功需得文火慢熬，假以时日，总能窥见门径的。”
少年默然点头，面庞上却泛起一抹与年纪不符的愁苦：
“理是这个理…只是觉得我这般驽钝，实在愧对大兄含辛茹苦供我向武的苦心罢了。”
背靠青砖，边吃边聊。
沈修寒才知晓少年名唤萧文，其兄长萧武大他五岁，在城外白家矿庄里做矿役。
兄弟俩皆是佃户出身。
萧武为给弟弟搏一个出人头地的造化，日日下矿，省吃俭用，才堪堪凑齐拜师束脩。
但萧文根骨平庸，桩功进境缓慢，只觉辜负了兄长的期盼。
萧文和他比烂，沈修寒可不敢骄傲，便多安慰了他两句。
见萧文馒头不够果腹，还分给他一个自己带的棒子面饼。
用罢午膳，沈修寒再次扎入演武场，苦熬桩功。
一遍又一遍，埋头苦练，挥汗如雨。
期间，徐川还来了一趟，帮他指点了桩架要诀。
还夸奖沈修寒进度快，能将四个桩架连续打出。
但沈修寒越练越觉得，这『玄鹰桩』不简单。
每多练一个桩架子，难度就提升不少。
直到暮色降临，沈修寒也没练出第五副桩架。
武馆的人越来越少，师父不见人影，徐川也早回去了。
沈修寒看了眼天色，也离开了。
他先去了趟东市，准备采购些东西，奈何天色向晚，不少摊贩收了摊，好在肉铺还开着。
买了五斤猪五花，又在一处老叟手上买了两串糖葫芦。
临出城前，还特意寻了一番麻显阳找来的两个眼线。
结果没看到他们。
content_en:
Holding the steamed bun, Shen Xiuhan found a corner and sat down, nibbling on it.
His eyes flickered, and a small hand grabbed half a piece of pickled mustard and handed it over.
Shen Xiuhan raised his eyes in shock and found a fifteen or sixteen year old boy next to him.
He was wearing an old coat full of patches. He was thin and slightly shy. At first glance, he was from outside the city.
"Senior brother, just eat it with pickles, it's so delicious..."
Shen Xiuhan was slightly startled, but he did not refuse. He stretched out his hand to take it and said:
"Thank you, but I just entered the outer courtyard today. According to the rules, I should call you senior brother."
"I only came two days earlier than my senior brother. I'm young and have weak bones. I don't dare..."
The young man waved his hands repeatedly, squatted down next to Shen Xiuhan, and said in an envious tone:
"During morning training, I saw that Senior Brother Shen had mastered several stances in just one morning. Those who are masters of martial arts take the lead, so I should call Senior Brother."
Shen Xiuhan was soft-spoken and simply used Mei Shuangfeng's words to comfort him:
"Master said that in the martial arts, the most important thing is to avoid being impatient. The skills need to be simmered slowly. With time, you can always get a glimpse of the door."
The young man nodded silently, but there was a trace of sadness on his face that was inconsistent with his age:
"This is the reason... I just feel that I am so stupid and I really feel unworthy of my elder brother who went through all kinds of hardships to support me Xiang Wu."
We leaned against the blue bricks and chatted while eating.
Only then did Shen Xiuhan find out that the boy's name was Xiao Wen, and that his brother Xiao Wu was five years older than him and worked as a miner in the Baijia Mine outside the city.
Both brothers were born as tenant farmers.
In order to give his younger brother a chance to get ahead, Xiao Wu worked in the mines every day and lived frugally, so he was able to get together and become a disciple.
However, Xiao Wen's skills were mediocre and his progress was slow. He felt that he had failed to live up to his brother's expectations.
Xiao Wen was worse than him, but Shen Xiuhan didn't dare to be proud, so he comforted him a few more words.
Seeing that Xiao Wen's steamed buns were not enough to satisfy his hunger, he even gave him a stick noodle cake that he had brought with him.
After lunch, Shen Xiuhan plunged into the martial arts arena again, working hard on the exercises.
Over and over again, practicing hard and sweating like rain.
During this period, Xu Chuan also came to help him with the key points of the pile frame.
He also praised Shen Xiuhan for his fast progress and his ability to drive out four pile frames in a row.
But the more Shen Xiuhan practiced, the more he felt that this "Xuanying Stake" was not simple.
Every time you practice a pile frame, the difficulty increases a lot.
Until dusk fell, Shen Xiuhan still hadn't mastered the fifth set of racks.
There are fewer and fewer people in the martial arts gym, the master is nowhere to be seen, and Xu Chuan has gone back early.
Shen Xiuhan glanced at the sky and left.
He first went to the East Market to buy some things. However, it was getting late and many vendors had closed their stalls. Fortunately, the butcher shop was still open.
I bought five kilograms of pork belly and two bunches of candied haws from an old man.
Before leaving the city, he specifically searched for the two informants that Ma Xianyang had found.
Didn't see them.
